summary: Iteration 2 (Smart Case Triage + Voice input + Guide handoff + Share) tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 new pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py plus previous 18/18 regression suite still green. Triage endpoint returns the required JSON shape (severity in critical|high|moderate, severity_label, summary, 1-5 prepare items, 1-4 do_not items, guide_slug + guide_title), correctly forces severity=critical for cardiac/unconscious/hemorrhage/choking, chooses guide_slug 'bleeding' (also acceptable 'head-injury') for the head-injury note, caches results on second call (<1s vs ~2.5s first call) and embeds the triage payload inside GET /api/emergencies/{id}. Invalid id -> 400 and unknown id -> 404 confirmed. POST /api/assistant/transcribe returns Arabic transcript for the /tmp/sample_ar.mp3 sample (audio/mpeg), returns 415 for text/plain, 400 for tiny (<200B) file, and 422 for missing 'file' field. POST /api/assistant/chat with 'طفل يختنق بطعام' yields a stream whose final done event carries guide_slug='choking' + Arabic guide_title, and the same slug persists on the assistant history message. Frontend (390x844 web preview): hemorrhage chip -> dispatch-note-input accepts note -> dispatch-submit-button navigates to /emergency/{id}; emergency-map renders, triage-loading shows briefly, then triage-card appears with triage-severity 'حرجة - تهدد الحياة' and triage-guide-button; tapping the button opens /guide/bleeding with guide-detail-back-button and back returns to the emergency screen; cancel-emergency-button works. Assistant tab: assistant-voice-button visible; tapping it in Playwright started recording (Chromium auto-granted mic) without crashing (input became readonly with the 'جارٍ الاستماع...' placeholder and mic swapped to stop icon). Sending 'طفل يختنق بطعام' via a suggestion chip produced a streaming Arabic reply followed by chat-guide-button (text 'اقرأ الدليل الكامل: الاختناق - مناورة هايمليك'), chat-share-button and chat-whatsapp-button; tapping chat-share-button did not crash; chat-guide-button navigated to /guide/choking. Regression: guides list=12, AED list=12, store list=10, Medical ID screen renders. No red screens or blocking errors. Web-only warnings observed (informational): shadow* style prop deprecation, useNativeDriver JS fallback, props.pointerEvents deprecation - all pre-existing and not iteration-2 specific.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: transcribe_audio accepts .mpeg/.mpga in the allow-list but AUDIO_EXT_BY_TYPE never maps to those suffixes; harmless but dead branch.

server.py: triage endpoint returns 502 if Gemini fails (no cache write); on retry via triage-retry Pressable the LLM is called again from scratch - acceptable since severity forcing still handles the critical categories server-side.
voice-button.tsx: on web the Alert.alert 'requestWithContext' path is skipped and browser prompt is shown directly - correct behavior for Playwright/Chromium.
share.ts: on web, when neither navigator.share nor navigator.clipboard exist, the function silently returns; caller in assistant.tsx should probably show an error toast in that path (minor).
backend server.py still ~1090 lines - consider splitting when adding iteration 3+ features.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Test emergencies + medical profiles created with TEST_IT2_ prefixed device_ids for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Triage LLM calls take ~2-4s (Gemini 3 Flash); cache path returns <100ms. Whisper transcription ~2-4s for the 54KB /tmp/sample_ar.mp3 sample; regenerate with `cd /tmp && python gen_audio.py` if missing. Assistant guide handoff is deterministic via keyword match on the assistant reply (_match_guide) - Arabic keywords like 'اختناق'/'يختنق' route to slug 'choking'. Frontend testIDs: dispatch-note-input, dispatch-submit-button, emergency-map, triage-loading, triage-card, triage-severity, triage-guide-button, assistant-voice-button, assistant-input (readonly while recording), chat-guide-button, chat-share-button, chat-whatsapp-button, guide-detail-back-button. Chromium in Playwright auto-grants microphone so the voice button starts recording; there is no crash - the Playwright fill('assistant-input') will time-out with 'element is not editable' while recording is active, which is expected. Use suggestion chips (text 'طفل يختنق بطعام' etc.) if you need to submit text without stopping the recorder first.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all iteration 2 features working as specified.
